# Importing HTML & JSON into R

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(jsonlite)

# Read HTML table
html_data <- read_html("books.html") |>
  html_element("table") |>
  html_table()

# Read JSON data
json_data <- fromJSON("books.json")

# Display both data frames
html_data
json_data
```

# Comparison Code

```{r}

# Compare the original data frames
identical(html_data, json_data)

# Convert HTML tibble to a regular data frame
html_data <- as.data.frame(html_data)

# Compare again
identical(html_data, json_data)

```

# Comparing HTML and JSON Data

I created two files containing information about three books on US-China relations. Both files were successfully imported into R with three rows and five columns.

Initially, the `identical()` function returned FALSE because the HTML data was imported as a tibble, while the JSON data was imported as a regular data frame.

After converting the HTML tibble using `as.data.frame()`, the comparison returned TRUE. This confirms that both files contain identical data.
